title: First Dryer Vent Cleaning in Years
description: I was called out for a standard dryer vent cleaning. When I arrive I found that the pest control company had installed a screen over the vent termination. I removed the screen and cleaned the vent. That said the screen had trapped so much lint that all the lint in the duct work was completely water logged and it took some work getting it clean. I was able to get it fully cleaned and the dryer is now working as it should
